items.text:
うんこを食べると体が重くなるという言い伝えがあります。
Study point: The grammar pattern 〜とある言い伝えがあります can be used to introduce an old or traditional belief or story related to the subject being discussed.
English translation: There is an old belief that eating poop makes you heavy.
